# Python JSON Logger

Python JSON Logger is a structured logging library.

!!! info "Overview"
    Outputs logs in JSON format for easy ingestion by log aggregators.

=== "Python 3.10+"
    ```python
    import logging
    from pythonjsonlogger import jsonlogger
    ```

=== "Python 3.8 - 3.9"
    ```python
    import logging
    # Legacy mode
    ```
